owner_requirements.project_scope: 本项目为氹仔污水厂排放管改道及周边平整工程，属市政与公共基础设施，采用DBB交付模式，总预算MOP 150,000,000，工期24个月。业主已判出施工包「排放管改道及管沟工程包」（CASE-0014/construction-1），由得宝建筑集团有限公司（COMP-0493）承担。本次业主方模拟招标包为材料采购包（CASE-0014/supply-1），仅向该施工包供应排放管改道及管沟工程所需材料与构配件，包括供货、运输到场、质量证明文件及质保期内更换；不含任何施工、安装、临时工程或措施费，不承担施工界面责任。材料费用已包含在施工包合同价内，由施工包承包商作为买方支付。本包预算MOP 19,635,000，候选供应商为COMP-0191与COMP-0154。业主方模拟目标为在规格基准、价差机制、质量文件义务和分批到场计划明确的前提下，取得可比报价并完成判给。
functional_requirements: 排放管材料须满足设计意图中的管径、材质与接口型式要求，形成可招标的技术规格基准，作为报价与验收共同口径。
供应商须按管沟开挖节奏分批供货到场，明确首批到场时间与后续批次间隔，保障管沟暴露时间受控。
供应商须随货提交批次质量证明文件，包括出厂合格证、检测报告和批次追溯记录，支撑闭水试验与回填压实验收闭环。
材料单价构成与价格调整机制须在报价基础中说明，明确基准期与支付节点，控制业主方作为买方的成本敞口。
供应商须提供质保期内更换责任安排及备件计划，保障运营期可维护性。
供应商须提供与施工包安装接口相关的技术资料，便于承包商协调敷设与接口作业。
technical_requirements: 排放管材料技术规格基准须由设计方在供应包招标前出具，明确管材等级、管径、材质与接口要求。
BIM协调：材料规格信息须与设计模型及施工包深化模型一致，接口信息可追溯。
MEP协调：排放管与厂区既有管线及临时排水系统的接口须在规格基准中说明。
结构协调：管材及支护构配件须满足管沟支护与回填压实的结构配合要求。
运输接口布局：供应商须说明运输路线、到场卸货点与现场堆放界面，与施工包作业面移交时序匹配。
公共访问布局：材料运输与堆放不得影响污水厂运营及周边公共通道，须在供货计划中体现。
耐久性目标：管材及构配件须满足设计使用年限与腐蚀环境下的耐久性要求。
可维护性目标：接口型式与备件供应须支持运营期检修与更换。
业主验收路径：以技术规格基准、批次质量证明文件和到场验收记录作为验收依据。
能源使用目标：材料生产与运输环节须体现可持续性目标，供应商须说明相关措施。
owner_requirements.budget_policy: 本包预算为MOP 19,635,000，费用已包含在施工包合同价内，由承包商作为买方支付。业主方模拟要求候选供应商在报价基础中说明材料单价构成、价格调整机制、基准期与支付节点。鉴于材料价格指数已升至1.1124，业主方将评估价差调整公式对成本敞口的影响，并要求按到场验收节点分期支付。业主方比较报价时采用定性原则，综合判断价格合理性、风险控制与交付信心，不以最低价作为唯一判给依据。
owner_requirements.schedule_policy: 总工期24个月。材料采购包须与施工包管沟开挖、支护计时、闭水试验及回填压实时序衔接。业主方模拟要求供应商提交分批到场计划，明确首批到场时间与批次间隔；设计方须在供应包招标前出具排放管材料技术规格基准，该时间点作为供应包招标与验收的共同口径。业主方将预留设计澄清、报价评审与判给所需的审查时间，并考虑材料运输与公共访问协调所需时间，确保关键路径时序可控。
compliance_requirements: 业主审查节奏：按招标文件澄清、报价基础评审、判给审批的节点设置审查关口，重大范围与预算变更须经宏观审批。
问题升级路径：规格基准、价差机制、质量文件义务等争议事项须明确升级至项目总监与商务合约部。
文档纪律：供应商须按批次提交质量证明文件并随货到场，文件缺失作为付款条件不满足处理。
接口签署：材料规格基准、运输到场计划与作业面移交时序须经设计方、施工包与供应商三方接口签署确认。
公共访问协调：材料运输与堆放安排须与污水厂运营及周边公共通道管理协调。
质量目标跟踪：以闭水试验与回填压实验收结果为质量目标跟踪依据。
安全期望跟踪：管沟暴露时间与支护计时纳入安全期望跟踪，供货断档须及时预警。
变更控制纪律：规格澄清、价差调整与供货计划变更须走书面变更控制流程，避免开标后澄清转嫁为施工包风险。
risk_priorities: 规格基准缺失风险：排放管管径、材质与接口型式未形成可招标技术规格基准，导致报价不可比与后续澄清风险。
价差机制不明风险：材料价格指数上升而调价公式、基准期与支付节点未明确，推高买方风险金与总成本。
质量文件义务不清风险：供应商仅承诺供货到场而不承诺文件随货，导致验收闭环受阻。
供货节奏断档风险：管材与支护构件未能按开挖节奏分批到场，拉长管沟暴露时间，增加塌方与临时排水风险。
接口协调风险：运输到场、卸货点与作业面移交时序未与施工包对齐，影响交叉作业面移交。

bid_document.implementation_plan: 1) 供货协调：设供货协调负责人一名，对接施工包承包商的管沟开挖进度计划，编制分批到场计划；首批到场时间与批次间隔按施工包开挖节奏协调，具体以供货协调确认的排产计划为准，作为投标假设写入。2) 分批到场：按施工包管沟开挖与管道敷设顺序编排批次，每批随货提交质量证明文件，到场后配合承包商验收。3) 质量与追溯：按设计规格基准编制质量计划，每批随货提交材质证明、出厂检验记录与批次追溯记录，并安排独立抽样送第三方检测。4) 质保期更换：质保期内经确认属材料缺陷的批次，按更换流程处理，责任边界以合同条款约定为准。5) 团队可用性：本包资源占用约0.25，现有可用资源2.0，供货协调与质量文件管理岗位按角色计划配置，当前可用性以内部排班确认为准。
bid_document.schedule_commitment: 供货期与施工包管沟开挖及管道敷设进度匹配：首批到场时间与批次间隔按施工包开挖节奏协调，具体以供货协调确认的排产计划为准，作为投标假设写入；每批到场后配合承包商到场验收，验收合格作为该批次付款节点。质保期自到场验收合格之日起算，期限以合同条款约定为准。
bid_document.compliance_statement: 我司接受业主方模拟对价格合理性、风险控制与交付信心的定性比较。报价以设计方排放管材料技术规格基准为共同口径，列明材料单价构成、价格调整公式与基准期，并按到场验收节点分期支付。付款节点与账期因买方为施工包承包商而尚未核实，本投标按到场验收分期作为投标假设写入，不作为已确认条件；商务核实账期后定稿。质量证明文件清单按拟议规格口径表述，以设计基准文件为准。
bid_document.risk_response: 主要风险为价格与回款：材料价格指数已升至1.1124，报价设价格调整公式并锁定基准期，避免涨价风险全部由我司承担；买方为施工包承包商而非业主，分期付款节点与账期尚未核实，报价按到场验收分期作为投标假设编制，并计提资金占用准备。质保更换责任在合同中限定为材料缺陷。设计规格基准文件尚未确认，供货清单与质量文件清单按拟议口径表述，待基准文件出具后复核。上述未决项均列为投标假设，不影响本包纯供货责任边界的清晰性。
bid_document.submission_summary:
中建八局第二建设有限公司以单一供货方身份独立投标本纯供货包，不含施工安装与界面责任，无需组合体。报价基础：以设计方排放管材料技术规格基准为共同口径，列明单价构成、调价公式与基准期（材料价格指数1.1124已计入），付款按到场验收节点分期，买方为施工包承包商，账期尚未核实，作为投标假设写入。
报价构成（MOP）：材料费14,280,000；运输到场及装卸配合1,185,000；质量证明文件与批次追溯486,000；质保期更换及售后742,000；备件与安装接口信息支持318,000；价格调整基准期风险准备596,000；企业管理费与合理利润1,033,000。合计18,640,000 MOP，低于包上限19,635,000 MOP。
上述金额为按拟议规格口径与投标假设编制的估算，非已收到的供应商报价；设计基准文件、买方付款节点与账期核实后复核定稿。

quotation_breakdown.item: 运输到场及装卸配合费

quotation_breakdown.item: 质量证明文件与批次追溯管理费
quotation_breakdown.basis: 材质证明、出厂检验记录、批次追溯记录编制与随货提交，含独立抽样送第三方检测的检测协调费用

quotation_breakdown.item: 质保期更换及售后支持费
quotation_breakdown.basis: 质保期内材料缺陷批次更换的材料与运输成本计提，责任边界限定为材料缺陷，以合同条款约定为准

quotation_breakdown.item: 备件计划与安装接口信息支持费
quotation_breakdown.basis: 常用备件储备计划编制与少量备件占用，以及向承包商提供书面安装接口信息与交底配合

quotation_breakdown.item: 价格调整机制基准期风险准备
quotation_breakdown.basis: 调价公式基准期与到场验收分期付款账期未核实所对应的资金占用与价格波动准备，按材料费一定比例计提

quotation_breakdown.item: 企业管理费与合理利润
quotation_breakdown.basis: 按上述直接成本合计的约6.5%计取，覆盖供货协调、合同管理与合理利润

bid_assumptions: 施工包承包商的分期付款节点与账期以商务核实后为准，报价按到场验收节点分期支付编制。
设计方排放管材料技术规格基准文件以招标文件所附为准，报价按该基准统一口径；如尚未附具，按拟议规格口径估算并待基准文件复核。
首批到场时间与分批间隔按施工包管沟开挖进度计划协调，具体以供货协调确认的排产计划为准。
质保期更换责任边界以合同条款约定为准，报价已包含质保期内材料缺陷更换成本。
本包为纯供货，不含施工、安装、临时工程或措施费，不承担施工界面责任。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: COMP-0191 remains the sole supplier for the pure supply package CASE-0014/supply-1: supply, transport to site, quality certification documents and warranty replacement of materials and fittings for the construction package. No construction, installation, temporary works or measure costs are included, and no construction interface responsibility is assumed. COMP-0191 shall provide written installation interface information (interface type, connection dimensions, sealing requirements, installation precautions) to the contractor for its construction briefing; interface construction responsibility remains with the construction package. Material selection shall follow the designer-issued discharge pipe material technical specification baseline document as the sole basis; COMP-0191 shall, within 14 days after that baseline document is issued, review the supply list and quality document list and submit them to COMP-0493 for review, and the lists are finalized only after COMP-0493 written confirmation. Before that baseline document is issued, the material cost of 14,280,000 MOP and the supply list quantities are provisional estimates and not the basis for final settlement. Quality responsibility is limited to material compliance, accompanying quality certification documents and replacement of material defects during the warranty period.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: The contract price is 18,640,000 MOP, within the package ceiling of 19,635,000 MOP, and covers the full pure supply scope. The price adjustment formula and baseline period stated in the bid are accepted and locked, with the material price index of 1.1124 already included in the price; adjustment shall be executed only per that formula and no other price claims shall be made. The material cost of 14,280,000 MOP and supply list quantities remain provisional until the design baseline document review is completed and confirmed in writing by COMP-0493. No price adjustment outside the authorized scope is permitted; any request requiring a price, currency, scope boundary, party, work share or resource commitment change remains unresolved and requires re-tendering.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment is made in batches: within 30 days after each batch of materials arrives on site and passes COMP-0493 acceptance, COMP-0493 shall pay the amount for that batch. The warranty period for each batch starts from the date that batch passes on-site acceptance, with the duration as agreed in the contract terms. COMP-0191 has no obligation to advance funds before the payment node is reached. Payment is made in MOP.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Within the period after signing, COMP-0191 shall submit a written batch delivery scheduling statement matching the construction package trench excavation rhythm, specifying the first delivery time and batch intervals, as a contract annex; once confirmed by COMP-0493, the scheduling statement constitutes a binding supply obligation. The first production run and first on-site acceptance shall not start before the design baseline document review is completed and confirmed in writing by COMP-0493. Each batch shall be accompanied by material certificates, factory inspection records and batch traceability records, and COMP-0191 shall cooperate with COMP-0493 on-site acceptance. COMP-0191 shall arrange independent sampling for third-party testing. During the warranty period, batches confirmed as having material defects shall be replaced under the replacement process, with the responsibility boundary limited to material defects.
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: Buyer COMP-0493 position is decided and binding: payment within 30 days after each batch passes on-site acceptance; warranty from the date of on-site acceptance with duration per contract terms; the 14-day baseline document review obligation as a precondition to first production and first acceptance; the batch delivery scheduling statement as a contract annex binding after buyer confirmation; and price adjustment only per the locked formula with index 1.1124. Bidder COMP-0191 assumptions are treated as accepted risk allocations or replaced with explicit obligations: the payment node is fixed as above; the design baseline review is a binding obligation with buyer written confirmation as the acceptance condition; the batch schedule is a binding annex obligation; warranty replacement is limited to material defects; and the pure supply boundary excluding construction, installation, temporary works and interface responsibility is confirmed. The material cost of 14,280,000 MOP and supply list quantities remain provisional until baseline review confirmation. No external documents are claimed to have been reviewed and no real-world approvals are claimed to have been obtained. Each party remains free to reject this draft.

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: COMP-0191 remains the sole supplier for the pure supply package CASE-0014/supply-1: supply, transport to site, quality certification documents and warranty replacement of materials and fittings for the construction package. negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: The contract price is 18,640,000 MOP, within the package ceiling of 19,635,000 MOP, and covers the full pure supply scope. The price adjustment formula and baseline period stated in the bid are accepted and locked, with the material price index of 1.1124 already included in the price; adjustment shall be executed only per that formula and no other price claims shall be made. The material cost of 14,280,000 MOP and supply list quantities remain provisional until the design baseline document review is completed and confirmed in writing by COMP-0493. No price adjustment outside the authorized scope is permitted; any request requiring a price, currency, scope boundary, party, work share or resource commitment change remains unresolved and requires re-tendering.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment is made in batches: within 30 days after each batch of materials arrives on site and passes COMP-0493 acceptance, COMP-0493 shall pay the amount for that batch. The warranty period for each batch starts from the date that batch passes on-site acceptance, with the duration as agreed in the contract terms. COMP-0191 has no obligation to advance funds before the payment node is reached. Payment is made in MOP.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Within the period after signing, COMP-0191 shall submit a written batch delivery scheduling statement matching the construction package trench excavation rhythm, specifying the first delivery time and batch intervals, as a contract annex; once confirmed by COMP-0493, the scheduling statement constitutes a binding supply obligation. The first production run and first on-site acceptance shall not start before the design baseline document review is completed and confirmed in writing by COMP-0493. Each batch shall be accompanied by material certificates, factory inspection records and batch traceability records, and COMP-0191 shall cooperate with COMP-0493 on-site acceptance. COMP-0191 shall arrange independent sampling for third-party testing. During the warranty period, batches confirmed as having material defects shall be replaced under the replacement process, with the responsibility boundary limited to material defects.
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: Buyer COMP-0493 position is decided and binding: payment within 30 days after each batch passes on-site acceptance; warranty from the date of on-site acceptance with duration per contract terms; the 14-day baseline document review obligation as a precondition to first production and first acceptance; the batch delivery scheduling statement as a contract annex binding after buyer confirmation; and price adjustment only per the locked formula with index 1.1124. The material cost of 14,280,000 MOP and supply list quantities remain provisional until baseline review confirmation.
